caseName: United States ex rel. Mecartney v. Colby
caseNameFull: United States ex rel. Harry S. Mecartney v. Bainbridge Colby, Secretary of State
summary: Error to the Court of Appeals of the District of Columbia.
attorneys: Mr. Harry S. Mecartney and Mr. W. C. Sullivan for plaintiff in error., Mr. Solicitor General Beck for defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for want of jurisdiction upon the authority of Farrell v. O’Brien, 199 U. S. 89, 100; Toop v. Ulysses Land Co., 237 U. S. 580, 583; Piedmont Power & Light Co. v. Graham, 253 U. S. 193, 195.
